IloSecurityParams.name: SNMPv1
IloSecurityParams.description: SNMPv1 is enabled. This configuration increases system vulnerability to attack.

IloSecurityParams.name: Secure Boot
IloSecurityParams.description: The UEFI Secure Boot setting is enabled. In this configuration, the UEFI system firmware validates the boot loader, Option ROM firmware, and other system software executables for trusted signatures.

IloSecurityParams.name: IPMI/DCMI Over LAN
IloSecurityParams.description: The IPMI/DCMI over LAN feature is disabled. This configuration protects the server to known IPMI security vulnerabilities.

IloSecurityParams.name: Password Complexity
IloSecurityParams.description: The Password Complexity setting is disabled. This configuration increases system vulnerability to attack.

IloSecurityParams.name: Minimum Password Length
IloSecurityParams.description: The Minimum Password Length is set to 8 characters or more. This configuration improves system security against attacks.

IloSecurityParams.name: Security Override Switch
IloSecurityParams.description: The server Security Override Switch (system maintenance switch) is disabled. In this configuration, iLO login authentication is enabled.

IloSecurityParams.name: Last Firmware Scan Result
IloSecurityParams.description: Last run firmware verification test has passed.

IloSecurityParams.name: Require Login for iLO RBSU
IloSecurityParams.description: The Require Login for iLO RBSU setting is disabled. This configuration allows unauthenticated iLO access through the UEFI System Utilities.
IloSecurityParams.recommendedAction: Enable the Require Login for iLO RBSU setting.

IloSecurityParams.name: Require Host Authentication
IloSecurityParams.description: The Require Host Authentication setting is enabled.

IloSecurityParams.name: Authentication Failure Logging
IloSecurityParams.description: iLO is configured to log authentication failures in the event log.

IloSecurityParams.name: Default SSL Certificate In Use
IloSecurityParams.description: Management processor's default self-signed certificate is in use.
IloSecurityParams.recommendedAction: Import a certificate signed by a trusted certificate authority.
